latency_scope: local warmed OpenSearch HTTP retrieval, not embedding or public API end-to-end latency
latency_order: deterministic per-query rotated system order and per-repetition rotation, interleaving all configurations; one excluded warmup per query/system
latency_budget: candidate heldout empirical p95 <= max(1.5 * baseline heldout p95, baseline heldout p95 + 25 ms)
latency_dependence_caveat: Ten repeated requests per task are correlated; 100 heldout requests are not 100 independent tasks and do not establish a production SLA.
expansion_decision: pending development-only feasibility and independent judging; must be recorded before heldout execution/unblinding
